rounds.title: The night the lights went out

lines.en: Come down! I saw them first!
Come up then. Oh, you can't climb.

1.sub: That summer, he always got the mulberries first.

2.sub: We tried all afternoon. Nobody won.

lines.en: Mine is stuck in that tree again.
Go get it. You're the best climber, right?

3.sub: That tree helped her win once, too.

4.sub: The last ice pop melted in his mouth.

lines.en: Then the one next to it is mine.

5.sub: The whole street was dark. Only the sky was bright.

lines.en: One, two, three... Here I come!
Found you! I can see your feet!

6.sub: One pull of the curtain, and he had nowhere to hide.

7.sub: He won. But tomorrow she was leaving.

8.sub: When the truck came in, nobody said a word.

lines.en: I can run faster than it!

9.sub: That was the last time she won.

lines.en: Look at me! I can touch the leaves!
You didn't even come down to help me...

10.sub: That day, he swung the highest. He didn't hear her crying.

11.sub: Two little frogs under two lotus leaves, waiting for the rain to stop.

lines.en: We said the loser plays the mum!
I don't want to wear a dress...

12.sub: That afternoon, he played the mum.
